name: NetworkLab Validation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  python-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Compile Python modules
        run: python -m compileall -q python
      - name: Run monitoring runner
        run: python python/monitoring/run_monitor.py
      - name: Run report generator
        run: printf '%s' '[]' | python python/reporting/generate_report.py

  powershell-validation:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Validate PowerShell syntax
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $errors = @()
          Get-ChildItem -Path powershell,tests -Filter *.ps1 -Recurse | ForEach-Object {
            $tokens = $null
            $parseErrors = $null
            [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($_.FullName, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$parseErrors) | Out-Null
            if ($parseErrors.Count -gt 0) {
              $errors += "[$($_.FullName)] $($parseErrors | Out-String)"
            }
          }
          if ($errors.Count -gt 0) {
            $errors | ForEach-Object { Write-Error $_ }
            exit 1
          }
          Write-Host 'PowerShell syntax validation passed.'
